input.goal: Crumble up the biscuit and combine with the mixture

sub_goals.text: Gather ingredients and prepare food processor parts.
Attempt to assemble the food processor blade.
Find the correct piece and figure out the assembly.
Wash and dry the center piece of the food processor.
Assemble the food processor blade and plug in the appliance.
Test the food processor and prepare it for use.
Add the first batch of biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the first batch of biscuits.
Add more biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the second batch of biscuits.
Add the remaining biscuits from the first packet and crush them.
Add a second packet of biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the second packet of biscuits.

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.sound_movement_binding: L2: which object movement coincides with the sound
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_near: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is nearest to a reference object
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_side: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment

plan.goal: Crumble up the biscuit and combine with the mixture

events.description: The person places the food processor bowl on the counter.
events.relevance: to have the equipment ready for crushing

events.description: The person places a packet of biscuits on the counter.
events.relevance: to have the ingredients ready for crushing

events.description: The person inserts the blade into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: to prepare the food processor for use

events.description: The person picks up the center spindle piece of the food processor.
events.relevance: to find the missing part needed for assembly

events.description: The person washes the spindle under running water.
events.relevance: to clean the part before it touches food

events.description: The person dries the spindle with a towel.
events.relevance: to remove water before assembly

events.description: The person places the spindle and blade into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: to complete the assembly of the food processor

events.description: The person plugs the food processor cord into the wall outlet.
events.relevance: to provide power to the appliance

events.description: The person presses the button on the food processor base.
events.relevance: to check if the food processor works

events.description: The food processor motor makes a whirring sound.
events.relevance: to confirm the motor is running

events.description: The person opens the packet of biscuits.
events.relevance: to access the biscuits for crushing

events.description: The person drops biscuits into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: to put the biscuits in the appliance

events.description: The person places the lid on the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: to prevent biscuits from flying out

events.description: The person presses the button to turn on the food processor.
events.relevance: to start the crushing process

events.description: The food processor makes a loud crushing sound.
events.relevance: to indicate the biscuits are being crushed

events.description: The person removes the lid from the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: to allow adding more biscuits

events.description: The person drops more biscuits into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: to add the next batch for crushing

events.description: The person presses the button to turn on the food processor.
events.relevance: to crush the second batch

events.description: The food processor makes a crushing sound again.
events.relevance: to indicate the second batch is being crushed

events.description: The person drops the remaining biscuits from the first packet into the bowl.
events.relevance: to finish the first packet of biscuits

events.description: The person presses the button to crush the biscuits.
events.relevance: to crush the remaining biscuits

events.description: The person opens a second packet of biscuits.
events.relevance: to access more biscuits

events.description: The person drops biscuits from the second packet into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: to add the second packet to the processor

events.description: The person presses the button to crush the second packet of biscuits.
events.relevance: to crush the second packet of biscuits

relations.ask: Why was the spindle dried before being placed in the food processor?
relations.answer_hint: The spindle was washed and needed to be dry before assembly.

relations.ask: What had to be done to the food processor before it could be tested?
relations.answer_hint: The food processor cord was plugged into the wall outlet.

relations.ask: What happened to the biscuits that were dropped into the food processor bowl?
relations.answer_hint: The food processor was turned on to crush the biscuits.

relations.ask: What was the state of the first batch of biscuits when more biscuits were added?
relations.answer_hint: The first batch of biscuits had been crushed by the food processor.

relations.ask: What was done with the additional biscuits dropped into the bowl?
relations.answer_hint: The button was pressed to crush them.

relations.ask: What happened to the biscuits from the second packet after they were added to the bowl?
relations.answer_hint: The button was pressed to crush the second packet of biscuits.

decision_points.why: The person decides to start assembling the food processor blade.
The person realizes a piece is missing or incorrect and decides to find the right one.
The person decides the center piece needs to be washed before use.
The person decides to proceed with assembly after washing the piece.
The person decides to test the appliance to ensure it works before adding ingredients.
The person decides to start adding the biscuits to the food processor.
The person decides to crush the first batch of biscuits.
The person decides to add more biscuits in batches rather than all at once.
Crushing the second batch is a repetition of the previous crushing action.
Adding and crushing the remaining biscuits from the first packet is a continuation of the batch process.
The person decides that more biscuits are needed and opens a second packet.
Crushing the second packet is a repetition of the crushing action.
The person has finished crushing all the biscuits and decides to move on to the next step of the recipe.
